instruction:
The file `/home/user/Desktop/test.lbr` is the library to inspect. On Linux, launch CadSoft EAGLE with `/opt/eagle-7.7.0/bin/eagle` (adjust to your install).

Run the library consistency check and save the resulting report as `/home/user/Desktop/consistency.md`. Requirements: 1. `/home/user/Desktop/consistency.md` must exist and contain at least 100 bytes of readable UTF-8 text. 2. The report must mention a missing-pad defect. 3. The report must mention a duplicate-pin defect. 4. The report must mention a missing-pin defect. 5. The report must mention an uncovered-pin or not-connected-pin defect.
